Initialize.note: Passing null is enough; no command sender object is needed.

CreateNewProject.note: lSaveType=0 and dwLanguageType=1 (Ladder) succeed; dwLanguageType=0 returns 0x1001. Language codes for R16: 1 Ladder, 2 ST, 3 SFC, 4 FBD/LD. lUserInterfaceMode 2 starts GX hidden, 0 and 1 show a window. R16 = series 0xa, type 0x1003 (GetPlcSeriesList / GetPlcTypeList list all codes).

ImportProjectXml.note: lImportFlags=0, lImportMode=1 returns 0. lImportMode=0 returns 0x1903 and imports nothing. A ladder XML only imports completely into a project that already received its PRM files; into an empty project it returns 0x1903 and part of the POUs arrive.

RebuildProject.note: lLabelAssignmentType 1 keeps the existing label assignment (returns 0x1aa6 on a project that was never converted), 2 reassigns (works right after an XML import), 0 and 3 return 0x1001. bCheckProgram=1 also runs the program check and fills lpdwCheckWarning. About 3 seconds.

OpenProject.note: lUserInterfaceMode 2 starts GX hidden and the process exits on CloseProject; 0 and 1 show a window that stays open after CloseProject. Every call starts a new GX process (one per project), 5 to 9 seconds.

Connect.note: Starts a hidden GX without a project and returns a call id. Product list calls work in this state, also with an all-zero call id.

Disconnect.note: Stops the GX started by Connect.

ProjectOpen.note: Returns 0x1001 after Connect with lUserInterfaceMode 2. No way found to open a project inside the GX started by Connect.

CloseProject.note: lOption 0 and 1 both close without saving.

GetPlcTypeString.note: Returns the CPU name, e.g. R16.

GetPOUNames.note: lPOUType 0, 2 and 4 list all POUs; 1 and 3 list programs only. Exact meaning not confirmed.

ExportProjectXml.note: bFormat=1. May return 0x1901 with a valid file. Ladder bodies (bodyMLD) are only written for converted POUs; an unconverted project exports empty bodies.

BuildProject.note: Returns 0 with no change on a converted project. Returns 0x1aa4 on a project without POUs and right after an XML import (a full conversion is needed there: use RebuildProject).

GetSystemHardwareConfiguration.note: 8 bases with the unit code of every slot.

GetFileListForDownload.note: Array stride is 561 bytes (pack 1), not the declared struct size.

ExportPlcFormatData.note: Writes PRM, PRG and other files into <folder>\$MELPRJ$\. Returns 0x5202 on an unconverted project.

ImportPlcFormatData.note: Needs a pack 1 _ST_PLC_FILE_DATA buffer with the real file size. PRM bytes as stored inside a .gx3 are accepted. Return code 0 does not prove the result; read the configuration back.

GetSimulatorNo.note: Returns 0x1020 when called before the simulator starts.

StartSimulator.note: lStartUpMode=0. May return 0x1026 while the simulator does start.

ReadDeviceRandom.note: Word devices (D, SD). The bit device SM400 returns 0x10000032 (device specification contradiction).

DeviceWriteRun.note: One word; the device name is a wide string.

GetErrorMessage.note: Returns only a generic text for the 0x1xxx range.

GetUnitDataListAll.note: Unit catalog of all series (638 units on 1.123D). The list for one CPU is this filtered by wSeries.

ExportProjectXmlExt.note: bFormat=1 with lExportMode 0 to 3 all return 0. File sizes differ slightly per mode; the difference is not analysed.

ExportObjectXml.note: Exports one named object. lObjectType=0 works for a program POU, an FB, a structure and a global label list. For a program POU 1 to 7 also work with different file sizes. Other combinations return 0x1902.

ExportProgramViewHtml.note: Returns 0x5214 for program file names taken from GetFileListForDownload.

GetProgramNo.note: Program file name to program number.

ExportUsedDeviceAndLabel.note: Writes a CSV of used devices and labels.

ExportLibrary.note: Writes the project as a .usl library.

SimpleVerifyProject.note: Compares with another project; lpbIsIdentical=1 for a copy. bstrReportFilePath is used as a folder and result.xml is written inside it.

SetProjectStatus.note: dwStatus 0 to 3 all return 0, but nothing observable changes (saved file, POUs, compiled flag).

RenameObject.note: lObjectType=1 is a program POU: the name changes and survives save and reopen; the project becomes unconverted. FBs, structures and global label lists did not work with any lObjectType 0 to 8 (1 and 8 return 0x1902, others 0x1001).

DeleteProjectViewObject.note: lObjectType=1 is a program POU: it is deleted, also after save and reopen; the project becomes unconverted. FBs, structures and global label lists did not work with any lObjectType 0 to 8.

SaveAsProject.note: lSaveType 0 writes a single .gx3, 1 writes a .gx3 plus projectlist.xml (workspace format), 2 returns 0x1001. lInheritanceRights=0.

ChangePlcType.note: Changes the open project in place (R16 to R32 with series 0xa, type 0x1004); no file appears at bstrNewProjectPath. After save and reopen the project is R32 and unconverted.

GetLabels.note: Returns 0 only for lLabelListType 4 with a POU name, with zero results (lClassFilter and lRequestedProperties were 0). 0 to 3 and 5 return 0x1001.

GetDefaultConnection.note: Returns the default connection name and settings. Writes far more than the declared 504-byte struct (data seen up to byte 3,588; a 4.6 KB buffer crashed the host). The leading fields (IP address etc.) decode as declared.

GetConnectionList.note: Count plus 1,018 bytes per connection. The name field came back empty; the name is returned by GetDefaultConnection.

SetConnectionList.note: Writing back the list exactly as read returns 0x1001, also with the name filled in. The real struct layout probably differs from the type library.

SetDefaultConnection.note: Returns 0 with the struct as read, but a changed IP address is not applied (modified flag 0, unchanged after reopen). The real struct is larger than declared, so this call is not reliable.
